messages:
sam: Heads-up — noticed a regression on mixed short+long traffic after the kernel selection tweak. Short-prompt throughput dips ~18% on p3 when long decode-rate-heavy requests arrive. Anyone else seeing KV churn and worse batching formation?

maya: Yea I saw the spikes on Thursday. KV hit rate drops and we get more tiny batches. Timeline: patch reverted kernel heuristic -> deploy -> 30m later: latency tail up.

sam: Repro steps I used: small harness that sends 60% 20-token prompts and 40% 1024-token continuations at 1.2 qps per worker. Command: `./bench --mix 20:1024 --qps 1.2 --duration 10m`. Perf summary pasted below.

bench-bot: Perf run 2765439900: p3-8x, model-rx-1, mix 20/1024, 10m
  overall RPS: 58 -> 49 (regressed)
  p50 latency: 42ms -> 58ms
  p95 latency: 210ms -> 380ms
  avg KV hit rate: 0.78 -> 0.46

leo: Interesting — kernel selector is probably switching to single-threaded quant kernels for long-decoding streams and that causes decode-rate slowdown that prevents coalescing. When the first long request starts, the admission policy moves tokens into a long-decode bucket and small prompts miss coalescing windows.

irene: I dug into the admission logs. We classify by `prompt_len_bucket` and `decode_rate_bucket`. Current boundaries: prompt_len: [0-64, 65-256, 257-1024, 1025+] and decode_rate (tokens/s): [0-50, 51-200, 201+]. The new kernel heuristic flips to kernel-v2 for decode_rate>180 which increases per-token latency for short bursts.

sam: Patch idea: add a transient coalesce override so small prompts get a short extra wait (5-8ms) when a long decode stream is in flight, to allow batching without blocking long-request fast path. Also lower token_budget target for mixed buckets.

maya: Can we tune bucket thresholds instead? If we move decode_rate boundary to 250, fewer streams trigger kernel-v2. That might reduce KV evictions because long KV caches don't get primed as often.

leo: Quick micro-profiling I ran: `perf record --call-graph` on decode hot path. Kernel switch increased L2 misses by ~12% on long-path, and KV eviction count per long-request jumped from 3->9. Stack snippet:
```
# short sample
dispatch_kernel() +0x34
kv_cache_lookup +0xa8
decode_step_fastpath +0x120
```

sam: What about admission policy change: when bucket composition is >30% small prompts, force kernel selection to multi-threaded low-latency kernel and set token_budget_target=768 instead of 1024 for that slab. That preserves short prompt latency but still gives long reqs decent throughput.

irene: We should be cautious — reducing token_budget reduces batching efficiency. Need 1) simulation on traffic mix 2) canary on one region. I can add a metric `coalesce_wait_savings` to measure how many short requests benefit.

maya: Agreed. Also propose adding a KV prefetch hint when we detect upcoming long decodes from same session: prefetch top-N KV entries so long-request cold starts don't evict short-prompt primes. Might help hit rate.

leo: I'll run a focused experiment: three configs A) revert kernel heuristic, B) decode_rate boundary -> 250 + token_budget 1024, C) coalesce override (5ms) + token_budget 768 + kv-prefetch. Will run 2h each with the bench mix.

bench-bot: Experiment queued: exp-id 2026-03-18-01 (A,B,C). Will post results to /tmp/exp-2026-03-18.log when done.

sam: For visibility: let's also snapshot kernel-selector metrics: `kernel.choice_counts`, `kv.evictions_per_min`, `batch.size_histogram` and `batch.formation_delay_ms`. If anyone wants to add other signals, ping.

maya: I'll add a short grafana panel and set an alert if p95 > 300ms for 10m during the canary. :eyes:

leo: One more quick tweak we can try after experiments: make decode_rate buckets adaptive with EWMA over 30s so transient spikes don't flip kernel choice immediately. That should smooth churn.

irene: Sounds good. I'll prepare a rollout plan with canary traffic slices (5%, 20%, 100%) and rollback criteria (p95+KV-eviction delta > 15%).

sam: Thanks all. Will follow up once experiment logs land. If exp-C looks good, prefer that since it targets both KV and coalescing.

bench-bot: Exp A done: revert -> baseline restored. Exp B in progress (0/3).
